description: This file defines the AuthApi class, which provides methods for authentication-related API calls such as login and profile retrieval. It uses an ApiClient to make HTTP requests and contains endpoint constants.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: A class providing authentication API endpoints, utilizing an ApiClient for network communication.

methods.name: AuthApi
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ApiClient with a base URL and a null token provider.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, returning a dynamic map of the response data.

methods.name: profile
methods.description: Fetches the user profile information using a provided token.
